sloka: जिज्ञासमाना वैदेही त्वाम् माम् च पुरुषर्षभ ।तस्या हि अन्वेषणे श्रीमन् क्षिप्रम् एव यतावहे ॥३-६१-१७॥
transliteration: jijñāsamānā vaidehī tvām mām ca puruṣarṣabha ।tasyā hi anveṣaṇe śrīman kṣipram eva yatāvahe ॥3-61-17॥

translations.english: O best of men, maybe Vaidehi has hidden in the forest intending to scare you and me. She wishes to test our love. O blessed Rama let us ransack the forest immediately.
